lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: You did well.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: We can now confirm that the substance not only exists, but is in excellent condition.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: In all the previous cases that I'd mentioned,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: the slime had either solidified or dried up,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: so we couldn't properly study it.
You've been studying it?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: I went up to check it out.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Of course, after coming back, I had to immediately replace my body with a new one.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: But thanks to that, I was able to come to several meaningful conclusions.
I'm confused.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Since you've performed admirably, I'll fill you in.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: That slime

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: is a calorie-dense liquid mixture consisting of narcotics and decay inhibitors.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: As awful as the smell is, it doesn't compare to the effects it would have on the body if ingested.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Suffice to say it would be catastrophic.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: It'll turn your brain into mush, and your mind will be consumed only with the desire to ingest more of the slime.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Due to its caloric density, it wreaks havoc on your body,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: but keeps you clinging onto life.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Even if you do die, your body won't experience decomposition.
But why would such a thing exist?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: let's put our brains together and think about this.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Raptures attack humans, do they not?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: That means that humans can be used as bait,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: a way to entice Raptures, perhaps.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: This is all pure conjecture,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: but...

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: If we were to suppose there was something that consumes Raptures,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: it could take a human, break them down to a point where they're immobile,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: but still alive, and use them to lure in Raptures.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Or even if the human bait does end up dying, they will continue to appear as if they were alive,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: so this hypothetical entity could still place them in areas to entice Raptures.
This is insane...

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: What's so insane about it?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: The surface is a place full of many mysteries.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Humans no longer rule the roost that is the surface.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: We cannot predict what changes may occur up there.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: There are potentially innumerable lifeforms

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: which we don't know

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: where they come from,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: what they are,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: or how they came to be.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: So we must think outside the box,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: No. 7.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: It may be the only thing that saves your life

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: when venturing into an unknown area.
I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Stay safe out there.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Should you encounter anything unusual again, please inform me.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: I'll be waiting to hear from you.
